## How it works

Two thin bars at the bottom of the screen:

- the built-in **progress bar** — how much of the deck you have shown;
- the **qountdown bar** just above it — how much of your allotted time you
  have used.

The clock starts when the presentation goes full screen (press `F`), and goes
back to zero when you leave full screen.

## Colours

- accent while on schedule;
- warning colour after 80% of the time;
- pulsing red once you run over.

Press `t` to pause or resume, `T` to reset.

Press `M` to type a new duration in minutes, then `Enter`.

## Configuration

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    qountdown:
      minutes: 15
      start: fullscreen
      label: true
      label-position: bl   # bl, br, tr, tl
```

See the [README](README.md) for the full list of options.
